alleys.note: west part of the 10' alley between 3rd and Martin that sheet 109 prints in full; here its lines stop at x~3530 (rest of the block is on sheet 109)

bends.note: Pearl runs E from Kilgour; at the Martin junction it turns SE (about 26 deg) past the fire engine house to meet E. Front

notes: Sheet is drawn with E. 3RD (50') across the top (north face y~256-265, south face y~437-444, centre y~350) and runs ENE onto sheet 109. Streets entering 3rd from the north, with names taken from sheet 127 where this sheet does not print them: KILGOUR (west edge, 40', east face x~400, west face off the scan, centre taken east face minus 20 ft; its pipe runs straight on north of 3rd, so cross), BAUM ST. (printed here; opening x~855-979, about 36 ft), OREGON (name from sheet 127; opening x~1680-1820, about 41 ft), RIVER VIEW PL. (name from sheet 127, where it is printed 15'; opening x~2422-2476), CELESTIAL (printed here at the top edge; opening x~2775-2900, about 36 ft, 40' on sheet 127). None of these continue south of 3rd. Kilgour runs from 3rd to Pearl along the west edge and ends at Pearl (its pipes turn into Pearl). E. PEARL (60', faces y~1718 and ~1932) forks at the fire engine house: MARTIN (50') leaves ENE (stone retaining wall on its north side) and Pearl turns SE; the gore tip of the fire house block is at (1808,1830). Martin's centreline (slope about -0.23, from 50 ft between the stone retaining wall and the fire house's north side) and the centreline of Pearl's SE leg meet at about (1494,1801), where Pearl's E-W centreline (y~1817) also passes, so the three-way point is (1490,1805), good to about +-25 px. Pearl runs SE to meet E. FRONT at (2465,2285) and ends there (T); Front comes in from sheet 107 at the west edge (60' printed, y~2830) only as water pipes across the rail yard, then has a north face (Rheinstrom Bros. block, 940-950 E. Front) from x~2518 eastward. COPPINS ALLEY (10', printed COPPINS ALLEY at the east edge, faces x~3812/3854) runs from Martin to E. Front. Martin is straight from the fork to the east edge (centre y~1520 at x 2800, ~1262 at x 3833). The double 36 in. / 20 in. water pipe corridor at x~1350-1510 running south from 3rd through the Martin Street Play Grounds and the rail yard is not a street. The Rheinstrom lot strip at x~3220-3290 between 3rd and Martin has sheds in it and is not a street. Railroad tracks, freight sheds and the river ignored. E. Front east of the Pearl junction has only a north face (Rheinstrom block); its centre is taken midway between that face and the first railroad track (about 40 ft); sheet 109 prints 32 in Front at the next alley, so the 60' printed at the west edge may only apply in the yard. The two short ENE lines at x~3228-3530, y~873-1022 are the west end of the 10' alley between 3rd and Martin printed on sheet 109; the narrow strip at x~3228-3245 running from it toward Martin is the 4 ft passage also shown on 109.
